preconditions.description: Each number in the input is an odd number greater than 61.
Each number in the input is less than 10^6.
The input terminates with a line containing the number 0.

postconditions.expression: output_primes == [] or (len(output_primes) == 3 and all(is_prime(p) for p in output_primes))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly three prime numbers.

postconditions.expression: sum(p**(1 if i == 0 else 2 if i == 1 else 3) for i, p in enumerate(output_primes)) == number
postconditions.description: The sum of the cube of the third prime, the square of the second prime, and the first prime equals the input number.
The primes are ordered from smallest to largest.
